causality.schrodinger_assertions: sample candles strictly before each anchor (schrodinger.py)

protocol.design: Amendment A2: both S1 arms are fitted once on ALL dev rows at the frozen dev anchor cadence (hourly) whose horizon targets finish before the holdout starts, then frozen and scored on every holdout minute from eval_start; S0 is the direct Born-rule readout on the same holdout rows (nothing to fit).
protocol.models: per-arm StandardScaler + L2 logistic C=1 (direction) / ridge alpha=1 (volatility), fitted once

ablation_summary.rule: claim only if a metric has >=9/16 improving cells and >=9/16 improving cells with paired bootstrap p-value below the Bonferroni threshold
ablation_summary.verdict: null: no evidence the with_schrodinger arm adds skill (pre-registered majority + Bonferroni rule not met)
